recovered_signal: User explicitly liked the H1 replay mechanism and requested materially deeper controls, LISTEN synchronization, word-level shaping, context explanation, visual export, and a compact shareable message-artifact link.
state_before: MESSAGE REPLAY H1 proved deterministic score-before-video but remained an isolated synthetic spike with one-line message, one retime button and no canonical LISTEN/LIVE seams.
delta: Promoted the mechanism to /fold-bloom/replay/ while demoting the old spike to DONOR.

LISTEN now opens REPLAY with exact source identity/profile key, current addressed interval, current position, BPM/phrase/section evidence, authored marks, addressed-message packet and shared ride profile.
When opened from LISTEN, REPLAY can follow and seek the live LISTEN playhead through the existing same-origin opener API; no universal session bus was added.
REPLAY writes the existing source-keyed LIVE/LISTEN ride-profile localStorage contract, so profile calibration remains one preference family across surfaces.
Added word-level cue / hold / emphasis shaping and snap-to-playhead.
Added editable authored operation type / cue / span / intensity plus add/remove/snap.
Added SOURCE/MAP/IMMERSION layers, DEEP/TRANCE/WOOD/VOID scenes, CLEAR/DRIVE/TRANCE/SOFT presets and all six current ride-profile axes.
Added explicit message context title/body so a recipient can understand why the addressed source moment matters.
Added compact self-contained compressed share link containing message/context/word cues/operations/experience/bounded source evidence/reference; local/private audio bytes are excluded.
Added full JSON export and visual-only WebM export; WebM is explicitly a projection of the score, not canonical state.
Added public root + LISTEN workflow entry and route/browser proof coverage.

authority.local_audio_bytes: remain browser-local; never embedded in replay share link

residue: No backend URL shortener. The link is compressed/self-contained so it works cross-device without introducing an external service or account dependency.
Shared links carry public source address only as a reference when one exists; recipient playback is not guaranteed.
Visual WebM currently has no source audio embedded because REPLAY does not own or duplicate LISTEN audio bytes.
Lived recipient comprehension and actual messaging usefulness remain human evidence.
stop: If the promoted surface passes machine gates, stop. Next change must come from one real LISTEN-sourced message/replay use or a reproducible defect; do not expand into a general DAW/timeline/social backend.
